title: $C^0$-Analogue of Ismagilov's Theorem
summary: We establish a topological analogue of Ismagilov's theorem concerning the first continuous cohomology of volume-preserving diffeomorphisms. For a closed oriented manifold \(M\) with volume form \(Ω\), we consider the group \(\mathbb{G}^Ω(M)\) of homeomorphisms obtained as uniform limits of smooth volume-preserving isotopies. We show that its first continuous cohomology with values in the Banach space of zero-mean continuous functions is isomorphic to the first de Rham cohomology of \(M\).
